baseline.rationale: Lowered from 609 by deleting habitica_hello_world, its input schema, and the localHints context (16 mutants). The greeting tool was scaffolding: every real tool talks to Habitica, and reading habitica-mcp://capabilities already proves the connection without credentials, so the demo tool only cost every client tool-list context. Previously raised from 549 after the mutate scope widened again: the only remaining exclusions are src/main.ts and src/mainHttp.ts, which do nothing but bind a transport and launch. Retiring the former composition-root and mcp-declaration-surface exceptions brought HabiticaMcp.ts, HabiticaMcpHttp.ts, ServerInfo.ts, HabiticaPrompts.ts, and HabiticaResources.ts under mutation, and the new tool titles, idempotency hints, parameter descriptions, and task resource template added the rest. A drop below this count means the scope narrowed again; the survived, errors, and noCoverage ratchets only move down.
